title: Multi-Period Martingale Optimal Transport: Classical Theory, Neural Acceleration, and Financial Applications
abstract: arXiv:2601.05290v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper develops a computational framework for Multi-Period Martingale Optimal Transport (MMOT), addressing convergence rates, algorithmic efficiency, and financial calibration. Our contributions include: (1) Theoretical analysis: We establish discrete convergence rates of $O(\sqrt{\Delta t} \log(1/\Delta t))$ via Donsker's principle and linear algorithmic convergence of $(1-\kappa)^{2/3}$; (2) Algorithmic improvements: We introduce incremental updates ($O(M^2)$ complexity) and adaptive sparse grids; (3) Numerical implementation: A hybrid neural-projection solver is proposed, combining transformer-based warm-starting with Newton-Raphson projection. Once trained, the pure neural solver achieves a $1{,}597\times$ online inference speedup ($4.7$s $\to 2.9$ms) suitable for real-time applications, while the hybrid solver ensures martingale constraints to $10^{-6}$ precision. Validated on 12,000 synthetic instances (GBM, Merton, Heston)

translated_title: 多期鞅最优传输：经典理论、神经加速与金融应用
translated_abstract: 本文为多期鞅最优传输（MMOT）开发了一个计算框架，解决了收敛速率、算法效率和金融校准问题。我们的贡献包括：（1）理论分析：通过Donsker原理建立了 $O(\sqrt{\Delta t} \log(1/\Delta t))$ 的离散收敛速率，以及 $(1-\kappa)^{2/3}$ 的线性算法收敛性；（2）算法改进：引入了增量更新方法（$O(M^2)$ 复杂度）和自适应稀疏网格；（3）数值实现：提出了一种混合神经-投影求解器，将基于Transformer的warm-start方法与Newton-Raphson投影相结合。训练完成后，纯神经求解器实现了1,597倍的在线推理加速（4.7秒→2.9毫秒），适用于实时应用，而混合求解器可确保鞅约束达到 $10^{-6}$ 的精度。该方法在12,000个合成实例（GBM、Merton、Heston）上得到了验证。
tldr: 本文为多期鞅最优传输建立了理论收敛速率分析，并提出结合Transformer warm-start与Newton-Raphson投影的混合神经求解器，实现了1,597倍的推理加速，同时将鞅约束精度保持在 $10^{-6}$ 水平。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes convergence rate theory for Multi-Period Martingale Optimal Transport and proposes a hybrid neural-projection solver combining transformer warm-starting with Newton-Raphson projection, achieving a 1,597× inference speedup while maintaining martingale constraints to $10^{-6}$ precision.
